title: Final Siege: The Demon King’s Throne
intro_text: The Demon King Koushik waits in the shattered throne room. You must combine all previous lessons—variables, conditionals, loops, structures, functions, and classes—to survive his multi-phase siege.

scenes.speaker: Demon King Koushik
scenes.text: YOU DARE CHALLENGE MY LOGIC? I WILL DELETE YOU FROM MEMORY!
